data.title: Account Age vs Transaction Volume Mismatch
data.description: Detects accounts less than 90 days old that exhibit transaction volumes exceeding the typical profile for mature accounts. Newly opened accounts with abnormally high volume are a primary indicator of purpose-built mule accounts created specifically to funnel illicit funds.

enrichment_required.source: Account analytics enrichment (account opening date lookup)

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Account Age vs Transaction Volume Mismatch")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection and selection_high_volume | count() by account_id > 20")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
account_age_days<90
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT" OR event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT" OR event_type="INTERNAL_TRANSFER")
peer_comparison="{'metric': 'transaction_count', 'threshold': 'percentile_95'}"
| stats count as event_count by account_id
| where event_count > 20

falsepositives: Legitimate new business accounts with immediate high transaction needs
Student accounts receiving financial aid disbursements at semester start
